body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction would deal Fire, Cold, Lightning or Acid Damage to the target. Response (unopposed): Reduce it by 2 and suppress one ordinary Burning or Poison Condition imposed by that Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit after the Action.
An adjacent willing creature also reduces Damage from that same Action by 1.
